description: Decode a JWT (JWS or JWE header), POST only (token in the JSON body, never in a URL): header, claims, alg/kid, exp/nbf/iat status with leeway, aud/iss checks, and security findings (alg none, HMAC alg-confusion risk, jku/x5u/jwk header keys, missing exp, odd kid). Optionally verifies the signature against a JWKS URL you supply, or one discovered from the token's https iss via OpenID discovery (fetched SSRF-safely): RS256/384/512, PS256/384/512, ES256/384/512, ES256K and EdDSA. Never trusts alg none. Price: $0.005 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/jwt-decode

discover.description: Verify via OpenID discovery from the https iss claim when no jwks_url is given

jwks_url.description: Optional JWKS (or single JWK) URL to verify the signature

token.description: Compact JWT in the JSON body (a "Bearer " prefix is stripped). Alias: jwt

name: jwt_decode
title: Jwt Decode
